title: Measuring Chain-of-Thought Monitorability Through Faithfulness and Verbosity
reasoning: The term 'faithfulness' in this paper refers to the transparency and accuracy of a model's internal reasoning process (Chain-of-Thought) rather than religious faith. While the paper uses an 'Unethical Information' cue to test model monitorability, its primary focus is on AI safety and the technical evaluation of reasoning traces, not on benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical systems.
